title: Which Great Gatsby character are you?
topic: Which Great Gatsby character are you
intro: It's summer on Long Island, 1922, and the party next door is spilling onto the lawn. Answer nine questions to find out who you'd be among the guests.

outcomes.name: Jay Gatsby
outcomes.tagline: A dreamer with a plan, a mansion and a light across the bay.
outcomes.description: You believe in big hopes and grand gestures, and you're willing to reinvent yourself to reach them. Your optimism is magnetic: people turn up to whatever you've organised, even if they're not sure who you really are. Just remember the future is allowed to be different from the past.

outcomes.name: Daisy Buchanan
outcomes.tagline: Charming, breezy and impossible to forget.
outcomes.description: You light up a room without trying, and people lean in when you talk. You love beautiful things, lazy afternoons and anything that keeps the mood light. Underneath the sparkle you feel things deeply, even if you'd rather not make a fuss about it.

outcomes.name: Nick Carraway
outcomes.tagline: The thoughtful observer everyone ends up confiding in.
outcomes.description: You'd rather watch the party than be its centre, and you notice everything. People trust you with their secrets because you listen and don't rush to judge. You're loyal, quietly funny and the one who remembers how the whole story really went.

outcomes.name: Jordan Baker
outcomes.tagline: Cool, confident and always a step ahead.
outcomes.description: You move through life with easy self-assurance and a dry sense of humour. You're independent, sporty and happiest when you're doing things your own way. Nobody rattles you, and you'd never wait around for someone else to make the plan.

outcomes.name: Owl Eyes
outcomes.tagline: The curious guest who wandered into the library and found the real story.
outcomes.description: While everyone else is dancing, you're checking whether the books on the shelves are real. You're delightfully curious, easily amazed and far more perceptive than people expect. A rare result: you're the one who sees through the show and still shows up when it counts.

questions.text: You arrive at a party where you know almost nobody. You…

answers.text: Find a quiet corner and watch the room
Slip away to explore the rest of the house
Strike up a chat with the most interesting person there
Keep an eye on the door for one particular guest
Settle somewhere comfy and let people come to you
